package main

import "core:strings"

import rl "vendor:raylib"

Editor_Panel :: struct {
	pos:         Vec2,
	line_height: f32,
	padding:     f32,
	width:       f32,
}

@(private = "file")
panel: Editor_Panel

editor_panel :: proc(w: f32, padding: f32 = 8, line_height: f32 = 20, bg := rl.BLACK) {
	rl.DrawRectangleV(0, {w, f32(gs.config.display.height)}, bg)
	panel.width = w
	panel.padding = padding
	panel.line_height = line_height
	panel.pos = {padding, padding}
}

editor_panel_row_increment :: proc() {
	panel.pos += {0, panel.line_height}
}

editor_panel_text :: proc(text: cstring) {
	rl.DrawTextEx(gs.font_18, text, panel.pos, 18, 0, rl.WHITE)
	editor_panel_row_increment()
}

editor_panel_button :: proc(text: cstring, bg := rl.GRAY, hover_overlay := rl.Color{0, 255, 255, 80}) -> bool {
	is_pressed := false
	is_hovered := false

	size := Vec2{panel.width - 16, 20}
	rect := rect_from_pos_size(panel.pos, size)

	mouse_pos := rl.GetMousePosition()
	if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(mouse_pos, rect) {
		is_hovered = true
		if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) {
			is_pressed = true
		}
	}

	text_pos := panel.pos + {8, 1}

	rl.DrawRectangleRounded(rect, 0.2, 5, bg)

	if is_hovered {
		rl.DrawRectangleRounded(rect, 0.2, 5, hover_overlay)
	}

	rl.DrawTextEx(gs.font_18, text, text_pos, 18, 0, rl.BLACK)

	editor_panel_row_increment()

	return is_pressed
}

editor_panel_textbox :: proc(sb: ^strings.Builder) -> bool {
	size := Vec2{panel.width - 16, 20}
	rect := rect_from_pos_size(panel.pos, size)

	text, _ := strings.to_cstring(sb)

	rl.DrawRectangleRec(rect, rl.GRAY)
	rl.DrawTextEx(gs.font_18, text, panel.pos, 18, 0, rl.BLACK)

	key := rl.GetKeyPressed()

	if key == .KEY_NULL {
		return false
	}

	if key == .BACKSPACE {
		strings.pop_byte(sb)
		return false
	}

	if key == .ENTER {
		return true
	}

	char := rl.GetCharPressed()

	strings.write_rune(sb, char)

	editor_panel_row_increment()

	return false
}



================================================
File: src/encoding.odin
================================================
package main

import "core:bytes"
import "core:mem"
import "core:os"
import "core:slice"
import "core:strings"

import "base:intrinsics"

import rl "vendor:raylib"

/*
+---------------------------------------+
| World_Data_Header                     |
|---------------------------------------|
| magic         (0x57475650)    4 bytes |
| version_major                 4 bytes |
| version_minor                 4 bytes |
| version_patch                 4 bytes |
| level_count                   4 bytes |
| tileset_count                 4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| Entity Table                          |
|---------------------------------------|
| magic         (0xEFBEEFBE)    4 bytes |
| entity_count                  4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| Name Length 1                 4 bytes |
| Name Length 2                 4 bytes |
| ...                                   |
| Name Length N                 4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| Entity Name 1            variable len |
| Entity Name 2            variable len |
| ...                                   |
| Entity Name N            variable len |
+---------------------------------------+
| Level 1                               |
|---------------------------------------|
| magic         (0xBEBAFECA)    4 bytes |
| id                            4 bytes |
| x                             4 bytes |
| y                             4 bytes |
| width                         4 bytes |
| height                        4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| Tile Data                             |
| (width * height bytes)       1 byte   |
| per tile                              |
+---------------------------------------+
| Spawners      (Optional)              |
|---------------------------------------|
| magic         (0xEFBEDEC0)    4 bytes |
| spawner_count                 4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| Entity Index 1                4 bytes |
| X 1                           4 bytes |
| Y 1                           4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| Entity Index 2                4 bytes |
| X 2                           4 bytes |
| Y 2                           4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| ...                                   |
+---------------------------------------+
| Checkpoints   (Optional)              |
|---------------------------------------|
| magic         (0xBEBADEC0)    4 bytes |
| checkpoint_count              4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| X 1                           4 bytes |
| Y 1                           4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| X 2                           4 bytes |
| Y 2                           4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| ...                                   |
+---------------------------------------+
| Powerups      (Optional)              |
|---------------------------------------|
| magic         (0xDEC0DEC0)    4 bytes |
| powerup_count                 4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| Type                          4 bytes |
| X 1                           4 bytes |
| Y 1                           4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| Type                          4 bytes |
| X 2                           4 bytes |
| Y 2                           4 bytes |
+---------------------------------------+
| ...                                   |
+---------------------------------------+
| Level 2                               |
| ...                                   |
+---------------------------------------+
*/

World_Data_Header :: struct {
	magic:         u32,
	version_major: u32,
	version_minor: u32,
	version_patch: u32,
	level_count:   u32,
	tileset_count: u32,
}

World_Data_Level_Header :: struct {
	magic:  u32,
	id:     u32,
	x:      i32,
	y:      i32,
	width:  u32,
	height: u32,
}

LEVEL_MAGIC :: 0xBEBAFECA
HEADER_MAGIC :: 0x57475650 // PVGW
ENTITY_TABLE_MAGIC :: 0xEFBEEFBE
SPAWNERS_MAGIC :: 0xEFBEDEC0
CHECKPOINTS_MAGIC :: 0xBEBADEC0
POWERUPS_MAGIC :: 0xDEC0DEC0

Tile_Value :: enum u8 {
	None,
	Solid,
	Spike_N,
	Spike_E,
	Spike_S,
	Spike_W,
}

world_data_save :: proc() {
	b := bytes.Buffer {
		buf = make([dynamic]u8, context.temp_allocator),
	}

	header := World_Data_Header {
		magic         = HEADER_MAGIC,
		version_major = 0,
		version_minor = 1,
		version_patch = 0,
		level_count   = u32(len(gs.levels)),
		tileset_count = 0,
	}

	bytes.buffer_write_ptr(&b, &header, size_of(World_Data_Header))

	// Create Entity Table
	bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(u32(ENTITY_TABLE_MAGIC)))

	entity_count := len(gs.entity_definitions)
	bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(u32(entity_count)))

	// Name lengths
	for k in gs.entity_definitions {
		bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(u32(len(k))))
	}

	entity_names := make([dynamic]string, context.temp_allocator)

	for k in gs.entity_definitions {
		bytes.buffer_write_string(&b, k)
		append(&entity_names, k)
	}

	for level in gs.levels {
		size_in_tiles := coords_from_pos(level.size)
		pos_in_tiles := coords_from_pos(level.pos)
		level_header := World_Data_Level_Header {
			magic  = LEVEL_MAGIC,
			id     = level.id,
			x      = i32(pos_in_tiles.x),
			y      = i32(pos_in_tiles.y),
			width  = u32(size_in_tiles.x),
			height = u32(size_in_tiles.y),
		}

		bytes.buffer_write_ptr(&b, &level_header, size_of(level_header))

		tiles := make([]Tile_Value, level_header.width * level_header.height, context.temp_allocator)

		for tile in level.tiles {
			coords := coords_from_pos(tile.pos - level.pos)
			tiles[u32(coords.y) * level_header.width + u32(coords.x)] = .Solid
		}

		for spike in level.spikes {
			coords := coords_from_pos({spike.collider.x, spike.collider.y} - level.pos)
			spike_value := Tile_Value.Spike_N
			if spike.facing == .Right do spike_value = .Spike_E
			if spike.facing == .Down do spike_value = .Spike_S
			if spike.facing == .Left do spike_value = .Spike_W

			tiles[u32(coords.y) * level_header.width + u32(coords.x)] = spike_value
		}

		bytes.buffer_write(&b, transmute([]u8)tiles)

		if len(level.spawners) > 0 {
			bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(u32(SPAWNERS_MAGIC)))
			bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(u32(len(level.spawners))))

			for spawner in level.spawners {
				coords := coords_from_pos(spawner.pos)
				index, ok := slice.linear_search(entity_names[:], spawner.type)
				if ok {
					bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(u32(index)))
					bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(i32(coords.x)))
					bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(i32(coords.y)))
				}
			}
		}

		if len(level.checkpoints) > 0 {
			bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(u32(CHECKPOINTS_MAGIC)))
			bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(u32(len(level.checkpoints))))

			for checkpoint in level.checkpoints {
				coords := coords_from_pos(checkpoint.pos)
				bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(i32(coords.x)))
				bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(i32(coords.y)))
			}
		}

		if len(level.power_up_spawns) > 0 {
			bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(u32(POWERUPS_MAGIC)))
			bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(u32(len(level.power_up_spawns))))

			for powerup in level.power_up_spawns {
				coords := coords_from_pos(powerup.pos)
				bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(i32(powerup.type)))
				bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(i32(coords.x)))
				bytes.buffer_write(&b, mem.any_to_bytes(i32(coords.y)))
			}
		}

		if !os.write_entire_file("data/world.dat", bytes.buffer_to_bytes(&b)) {
			panic("Failed to write world file")
		}
	}
}

world_data_load :: proc() {
	data, ok := os.read_entire_file("data/world.dat", context.temp_allocator)
	if !ok {
		panic("Failed to read world file")
	}

	header: World_Data_Header

	r: bytes.Reader
	bytes.reader_init(&r, data)

	n_header, err_header := bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(header))
	assert(n_header == size_of(World_Data_Header) && err_header == nil)

	assert(header.magic == HEADER_MAGIC)

	// Construct Entity Table
	entity_table_magic: u32
	bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(entity_table_magic))

	entity_count: u32
	bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(entity_count))

	name_lengths := make([dynamic]u32, context.temp_allocator)
	names := make([dynamic]string, context.temp_allocator)

	for _ in 0..< entity_count {
		name_length: u32
		bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(u32(name_length)))
		append(&name_lengths, name_length)
	}

	for i in 0..< entity_count {
		name := make([]u8, name_lengths[i], context.temp_allocator)
		bytes.reader_read(&r, name)
		append(&names, string(name))
	}

	for _ in 0 ..< header.level_count {
		level: Level
		level_header: World_Data_Level_Header
		n, err := bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(level_header))

		assert(err == nil)
		assert(n == size_of(World_Data_Level_Header))
		assert(level_header.magic == LEVEL_MAGIC)

		level.id = level_header.id
		level.pos = pos_from_coords({level_header.x, level_header.y})
		level.size = pos_from_coords({i32(level_header.width), i32(level_header.height)})

		for y in 0 ..< level_header.height {
			for x in 0 ..< level_header.width {
				tile_byte: u8
				bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(tile_byte))
				tile_value := transmute(Tile_Value)tile_byte

				pos := level.pos + pos_from_coords({i32(x), i32(y)})

				switch tile_value {
				case .None:
					append(&level.bg_tiles, Tile {pos = pos})
					append(&level.mid_tiles, Tile {pos = pos})
				case .Solid:
					append(&level.tiles, Tile {pos = pos})
					append(&level.mid_tiles, Tile {pos = pos})
				case .Spike_N:
					append(&level.spikes, Spike {collider = {pos.x, pos.y + SPIKE_DIFF, SPIKE_BREADTH, SPIKE_DEPTH}, facing = .Up})
					append(&level.bg_tiles, Tile {pos = pos})
				case .Spike_E:
					append(&level.spikes, Spike {collider = {pos.x, pos.y, SPIKE_DEPTH, SPIKE_BREADTH}, facing = .Right})
					append(&level.bg_tiles, Tile {pos = pos})
				case .Spike_S:
					append(&level.spikes, Spike {collider = {pos.x, pos.y, SPIKE_BREADTH, SPIKE_DEPTH}, facing = .Down})
					append(&level.bg_tiles, Tile {pos = pos})
				case .Spike_W:
					append(&level.spikes, Spike {collider = {pos.x + SPIKE_DIFF, pos.y, SPIKE_DEPTH, SPIKE_BREADTH}, facing = .Left})
					append(&level.bg_tiles, Tile {pos = pos})
				}
			}
		}

		spawners_magic: u32
		bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(spawners_magic))

		if spawners_magic == SPAWNERS_MAGIC {
			spawner_count: u32
			bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(spawner_count))

			for _ in 0..< spawner_count {
				index: u32
				x, y: i32
				bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(index))
				bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(x))
				bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(y))

				append(&level.spawners, Spawner {
					pos = Vec2{f32(x), f32(y)} * TILE_SIZE,
					type = strings.clone(names[index])
				})
			}
		} else {
			for _ in 0..< 4 do bytes.reader_unread_byte(&r)
		}

		checkpoints_magic: u32
		bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(checkpoints_magic))

		if checkpoints_magic == CHECKPOINTS_MAGIC {
			checkpoint_count: u32
			bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(checkpoint_count))

			for _ in 0..< checkpoint_count {
				x, y: i32
				bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(x))
				bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(y))

				append(&level.checkpoints, Checkpoint {
					pos = Vec2{f32(x), f32(y)} * TILE_SIZE,
				})
			}
		} else {
			for _ in 0..< 4 do bytes.reader_unread_byte(&r)
		}

		powerups_magic: u32
		bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(powerups_magic))

		if powerups_magic == POWERUPS_MAGIC {
			checkpoint_count: u32
			bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(checkpoint_count))

			for _ in 0..< checkpoint_count {
				t: u32
				x, y: i32
				bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(t))
				bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(x))
				bytes.reader_read(&r, mem.any_to_bytes(y))

				append(&level.power_up_spawns, Power_Up_Spawn {
					pos = Vec2{f32(x), f32(y)} * TILE_SIZE,
					type = Power_Up_Type(t)
				})
			}
		} else {
			for _ in 0..< 4 do bytes.reader_unread_byte(&r)
		}

		recreate_colliders(level.pos, &gs.colliders, gs.falling_logs[:], level.tiles[:])

		append(&gs.levels, level)
	}

	// Add adjacent levels
	for &level in gs.levels {
		expanded_rect := rect_from_pos_size(level.pos - TILE_SIZE, level.size + TILE_SIZE * 2)

		for other_level in gs.levels {
			if level.id == other_level.id do continue

			if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(expanded_rect, rect_from_pos_size(other_level.pos, other_level.size)) {
				append(&level.adjacent_level_ids, other_level.id)
			}
		}
	}
}



================================================
File: src/entity.odin
================================================
package main

import "core:math/rand"

import rl "vendor:raylib"

entity_update :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, dt: f32) {
	for &e in gs.entities {
		if .Dead in e.flags do continue

		if e.on_update != nil {
			e.on_update(&e, gs, dt)
			continue
		}

		if e.hit_timer > 0 {
			e.hit_timer -= dt
			if e.hit_timer <= 0 {
				#partial switch e.hit_response {
				case .Stop:
					e.behaviors += {.Walk}
					e.flags -= {.Frozen}
				}
			}
		}

		if len(e.animations) > 0 {
			entity_animate(&e, dt)
		}

	}
}

entity_animate :: proc(e: ^Entity, dt: f32) {
	anim := e.animations[e.current_anim_name]

	// Switch frames?
	if .Frozen not_in e.flags {
		e.animation_timer -= dt
	}

	if e.animation_timer <= 0 {
		e.current_anim_frame += 1
		remaining_time := e.animation_timer // This will be negative
		e.animation_timer = anim.time + remaining_time

		if .Loop in anim.flags {
			if e.current_anim_frame > anim.end {
				e.current_anim_frame = anim.start
			}
		} else {
			if e.current_anim_frame > anim.end {
				e.current_anim_frame -= 1
				if anim.on_finish != nil {
					anim.on_finish(gs, e)
				}
				e.animation_timer = 0
			}
		}
	}

	// Events?
	for &event in anim.timed_events {
		if event.timer > 0 {
			event.timer -= dt
			if event.timer <= 0 {
				event.callback(gs, e)
			}
		}
	}
}

entity_create :: proc(entity: Entity) -> Entity_Id {
	for &e, i in gs.entities {
		if .Dead in e.flags {
			e = entity
			e.flags -= {.Dead}
			return Entity_Id(i)
		}
	}

	index := len(gs.entities)
	append(&gs.entities, entity)

	return Entity_Id(index)
}

entity_spawn :: proc(type: string, pos: Vec2) -> Entity_Id {
	def := &gs.entity_definitions[type]

	e := Entity {
		collider = {
			x = pos.x,
			y = pos.y,
			width = def.collider_size.x,
			height = def.collider_size.y,
		},
		hitbox = def.hitbox,
		hurtbox = def.hurtbox,
		move_speed = def.move_speed,
		jump_force = def.jump_force,
		behaviors = def.behaviors,
		health = def.health,
		max_health = def.health,
		debug_color = def.debug_color == nil ? rl.YELLOW : def.debug_color.?,
		definition = def,
		current_anim_name = def.initial_animation,
		texture = def.texture,
		hit_response = def.hit_response,
		hit_duration = def.hit_duration,
		flags = def.flags,
		on_hit_damage = def.on_hit_damage,

		on_enter = def.on_enter,
		on_update = def.on_update,
		on_death = def.on_death,
		on_hit_static = def.on_hit_static,

		shader = def.shader,
	}

	for k, v in def.animations {
		e.animations[k] = v
	}

	id := entity_create(e)

	return id
}

entity_get :: proc(id: Entity_Id) -> ^Entity {
	if int(id) >= len(gs.entities) {
		return nil
	}
	return &gs.entities[int(id)]
}

entity_destroy :: proc(id: Entity_Id) {
	if int(id) < len(gs.entities) {
		unordered_remove(&gs.entities, int(id))
	}
}

switch_animation :: proc(entity: ^Entity, name: string) {
	entity.current_anim_name = name
	anim := &entity.animations[name] // Get Pointer to reset event timers
	entity.animation_timer = anim.time
	entity.current_anim_frame = anim.start

	for &event in anim.timed_events {
		event.timer = event.duration
	}
}

entity_damage :: proc(id: Entity_Id, amount: int) {
	entity := entity_get(id)
	entity.health -= amount
	if entity.health <= 0 && .Immortal not_in entity.flags {
		entity.flags += {.Dead}
		if entity.on_death != nil {
			entity->on_death(gs)
		}

		for drop in entity.definition.drops {
			if rand.float32() <= drop.chance {
				count := rand.int_max(drop.range[1] + 1 - drop.range[0]) + drop.range[0]

				for _ in 0 ..< count {
					spawn_pos := rect_center(entity.collider)
					spawn_pos.y = entity.collider.y + entity.collider.height - 16
					item_spawn(gs, drop.type, spawn_pos)
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

entity_hit :: proc(id: Entity_Id, hit_force := Vec2{}) {
	entity := entity_get(id)
	entity.hit_timer = entity.hit_duration

	switch entity.hit_response {
	case .None:
	case .Stop:
		entity.behaviors -= {.Walk}
		entity.flags += {.Frozen}
		entity.vel = 0
	case .Knockback:
		entity.vel += hit_force
	}
}



================================================
File: src/grass.odin
================================================
package main

import rl "vendor:raylib"

Grass_Values :: struct {
	shader_locations: struct {
		time:            i32,
		strength:        i32,
		speed:           i32,
		threshold:       i32,
	},
	sway_strength:  f32,
	sway_speed:     f32,
	sway_threshold: f32,
	is_initialized: bool,
}

@(private="file")
grass_values := Grass_Values {
	sway_strength  = 0.025,
	sway_speed     = 0.75,
	sway_threshold = 0.70,
}

grass_update :: proc() {
	if !grass_values.is_initialized {
		grass_values.is_initialized = true

		grass_values.shader_locations.time = rl.GetShaderLocation(gs.grass_shader, "time")
		grass_values.shader_locations.strength = rl.GetShaderLocation(gs.grass_shader, "strength")
		grass_values.shader_locations.speed = rl.GetShaderLocation(gs.grass_shader, "speed")
		grass_values.shader_locations.threshold = rl.GetShaderLocation(gs.grass_shader, "threshold")

		rl.SetShaderValue(gs.grass_shader, grass_values.shader_locations.strength, &grass_values.sway_strength, .FLOAT)
		rl.SetShaderValue(gs.grass_shader, grass_values.shader_locations.speed, &grass_values.sway_speed, .FLOAT)
		rl.SetShaderValue(gs.grass_shader, grass_values.shader_locations.threshold, &grass_values.sway_threshold, .FLOAT)
	}

	rl.SetShaderValue(gs.grass_shader, grass_values.shader_locations.time, &gs.elapsed_time, .FLOAT)
}



================================================
File: src/item.odin

package main

item_src :: proc(type: Item_Type) -> Vec2 {
	src: Vec2
	#partial switch type {
	case .Necrotic_Tail:
		src.x = 16
	case .Strange_Bacon:
		src.x = 32
	case .Lucky_Foot:
		src.x = 48
	}
	return src
}

item_spawn :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, type: Item_Type, pos: Vec2) {
	// I'd really like to know whether storing a Vec2 on here is
	// cheaper than looking up each frame
	src := item_src(type)
	append(&gs.items, Item{type = type, src = src, pos = pos})
}

inventory_add :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, type: Item_Type, count: int) {
	did_add := false
	for &slot in gs.inventory {
		if slot.item_type == type {
			slot.count += count
			did_add = true
			break
		}
	}

	if !did_add {
		slot := Inventory_Slot {
			item_type = type,
			src       = item_src(type),
			count     = count,
		}
		append(&gs.inventory, slot)
	}
}

// TODO: Move this into the main proc, not a global
// Anywhere gs is used as an argument, reduce the parameters to only requried fields
// ATM gs is used in a few procs without being passed in - this makes debugging harder
// as we can't tell from the proc type which procs alter the state if they use the global
gs: ^Game_State

recreate_colliders :: proc(
	world_pos: Vec2,
	colliders: ^[dynamic]Rect,
	falling_logs: []Falling_Log,
	tiles: []Tile,
) {
	clear(colliders)

	slice.sort_by(tiles, proc(a, b: Tile) -> bool {
		if a.pos.y != b.pos.y do return a.pos.y < b.pos.y
		return a.pos.x < b.pos.x
	})

	solid_tiles := make([dynamic]Rect, context.temp_allocator)
	for t in tiles {
		append(
			&solid_tiles,
			Rect{t.pos.x - world_pos.x, t.pos.y - world_pos.y, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE},
		)
	}

	if len(solid_tiles) > 0 {
		combine_colliders(world_pos, solid_tiles[:], &gs.colliders)
	}

	for falling_log in gs.falling_logs {
		if falling_log.state == .Settled {
			append(colliders, falling_log.collider)
		}
	}
}

combine_colliders :: proc(world_pos: Vec2, solid_tiles: []Rect, colliders: ^[dynamic]Rect) {
	wide_rect := solid_tiles[0]
	wide_rects := make([dynamic]Rect, context.temp_allocator)

	for i in 1 ..< len(solid_tiles) {
		rect := solid_tiles[i]

		if rect.x == wide_rect.x + wide_rect.width && rect.y == wide_rect.y {
			wide_rect.width += TILE_SIZE
		} else {
			append(&wide_rects, wide_rect)
			wide_rect = rect
		}
	}

	append(&wide_rects, wide_rect)

	slice.sort_by(wide_rects[:], proc(a, b: Rect) -> bool {
		if a.x != b.x do return a.x < b.x
		return a.y < b.y
	})

	big_rect := wide_rects[0]

	for i in 1 ..< len(wide_rects) {
		rect := wide_rects[i]

		if rect.x == big_rect.x &&
		   big_rect.width == rect.width &&
		   big_rect.y + big_rect.height == rect.y {
			big_rect.height += TILE_SIZE
		} else {
			big_rect.x += world_pos.x
			big_rect.y += world_pos.y
			append(colliders, big_rect)
			big_rect = rect
		}
	}

	big_rect.x += world_pos.x
	big_rect.y += world_pos.y
	append(colliders, big_rect)
}

level_from_id :: proc(levels: []Level, id: u32) -> ^Level {
	for &l in levels {
		if l.id == id {
			return &l
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Returns -1 on failure
level_index_from_id :: proc(levels: []Level, id: u32) -> int {
	for l, i in levels {
		if l.id == id {
			return i
		}
	}
	return -1
}

level_load :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, id: u32, player_spawn: Maybe(Vec2) = nil) {
	level := level_from_id(gs.levels[:], id)
	if level == nil {
		log.fatalf("Level with id `%d` could not be found.", id)
	}
	gs.level = level

	// Initial load
	if .Autotile_Has_Run not_in level.flags {
		autotile_run_bg(level)
	}

	for other_level_id in level.adjacent_level_ids {
		other_level := level_from_id(gs.levels[:], other_level_id)

		if .Autotile_Has_Run not_in other_level.flags {
			thread.create_and_start_with_data(other_level, autotile_run_bg)
		}
	}

	player := entity_get(gs.player_id)
	changing_levels := false
	old_player: Entity

	if player != nil {
		changing_levels = true
		old_player = player^
	}

	clear(&gs.entities)

	spawn_player(gs)

	// NOTE: Player will always have animation after first spawn
	// This will be skipped on first load
	player = entity_get(gs.player_id)

	if changing_levels {
		player^ = old_player
	}

	if pos, ok := player_spawn.?; ok {
		player.x = pos.x
		player.y = pos.y
	} else {
		player.x = gs.checkpoint_pos.x
		player.y = gs.checkpoint_pos.y
	}

	for spawner in level.spawners {
		entity_spawn(spawner.type, spawner.pos)
	}

	for tile in level.mid_tiles {
		grass_entity_id := entity_spawn("Grass", tile.pos)
		grass_entity := entity_get(grass_entity_id)

		if rand.float32() < 0.5 {
			switch_animation(grass_entity, "variant2")
		}
	}

	recreate_colliders(level.pos, &gs.colliders, gs.falling_logs[:], level.tiles[:])

	save_data_update(gs)
	savefile_save(gs.save_data)

	if level.on_enter != nil {
		level.on_enter(gs)
	}

	for powerup in level.power_up_spawns {
		switch powerup.type {
		case .Dash:
			if .Dash not_in gs.save_data.collected_power_ups {
				entity_spawn("Powerup:Dash", powerup.pos)
			}
		}
	}
}

spawn_player :: proc(gs: ^Game_State) {
	gs.player_id = entity_spawn("Player", gs.checkpoint_pos)
}


texture_load :: proc(path: string) -> int {
	if len(gs.textures) == 0 {
		// The nil texture
		append(&gs.textures, rl.Texture2D{})
	}

	texture := rl.LoadTexture(fmt.ctprintf(path))
	append(&gs.textures, texture)
	return len(gs.textures) - 1
}

game_init :: proc(gs: ^Game_State) {
	gs.last_update_time = time.now()

	// Load player texture
	gs.player_texture = texture_load("assets/textures/player_120x80.png")
	gs.item_texture = texture_load("assets/textures/items_16x16.png")

	gs.sword_swoosh_sound = rl.LoadSound("assets/sounds/player_sword_swing.wav")
	gs.sword_swoosh_sound_2 = rl.LoadSound("assets/sounds/player_sword_swing_2.wav")
	gs.sword_hit_soft_sound = rl.LoadSound("assets/sounds/sword_hit_soft.wav")
	gs.sword_hit_medium_sound = rl.LoadSound("assets/sounds/sword_hit_medium.wav")
	gs.sword_hit_stone_sound = rl.LoadSound("assets/sounds/sword_hit_stone.wav")
	gs.player_jump_sound = rl.LoadSound("assets/sounds/player_jump.wav")

	gs.bgm = rl.LoadMusicStream("assets/music/bgm.ogg")
	rl.PlayMusicStream(gs.bgm)

	player_def := Entity_Definition {
		collider_size     = {14, 38},
		hurtbox           = {3, 4, 8, 30},
		hitbox            = {0, 0, 14, 38},
		move_speed        = 220,
		jump_force        = 650,
		health            = 7,
		debug_color       = rl.GREEN,
		texture           = gs.player_texture,
		initial_animation = "idle",
		on_enter          = player_on_enter,
		on_death          = player_on_death,
	}

	player_def.animations["idle"] = Animation {
		size           = {120, 80},
		offset         = {52, 42},
		offset_flipped = {52, 42},

	}

		offset_flipped = {52, 42},

		end            = 3,
		row            = 3,
		time           = 0.05,
	}

	attack_2_timed_events: [dynamic]Animation_Event

	append(
		&attack_2_timed_events,

	)
	append(
		&attack_2_timed_events,

	)
