		offset_flipped = {52, 42},
		start          = 0,
		end            = 5,
		row            = 4,
		time           = 0.05,
		timed_events   = attack_2_timed_events,
	}

	if attack_anim, attack_anim_ok := &player_def.animations["attack"]; attack_anim_ok {
		append(
			&attack_anim.timed_events,
			Animation_Event{timer = 0.01, duration = 0.01, callback = player_attack_sfx},
		)
		append(
			&attack_anim.timed_events,
			Animation_Event{timer = 0.05, duration = 0.05, callback = player_attack_callback},
		)
	}

	player_def.animations["dash"] = Animation {
		size           = {120, 80},
		offset         = {52, 42},
		offset_flipped = {52, 42},
		start          = 4,
		end            = 5,
		row            = 3,
		time           = 0.075,
	}

	gs.entity_definitions["Player"] = player_def

	gs.entity_definitions["Walker"] = Entity_Definition {
		collider_size     = {24, 12},
		hitbox            = {0, 0, 24, 12},
		hurtbox           = {-6, 0, 36, 12},
		move_speed        = 35,
		health            = 3,
		flags             = {.Bleeds},
		behaviors         = {.Walk, .Flip_At_Wall, .Flip_At_Edge},
		on_hit_damage     = 1,
		texture           = texture_load("assets/textures/opossum_36x28.png"),
		initial_animation = "walk",
		hit_response      = .Stop,
		hit_duration      = 0.25,
	}

	if walker, walker_ok := &gs.entity_definitions["Walker"]; walker_ok {
		walker.animations["walk"] = Animation {
			size           = {36, 28},
			offset         = {6, 16},
			offset_flipped = {6, 16},
			start          = 0,
			end            = 5,
			time           = 0.15,
			flags          = {.Loop},
		}

		append(&walker.drops, Drop{type = .Necrotic_Tail, chance = 1, range = 1})
	}

	gs.entity_definitions["Jumper"] = Entity_Definition {
		collider_size     = {18, 16},
		hitbox            = {3, 2, 12, 12},
		hurtbox           = {1, 0, 16, 16},
		health            = 2,
		flags             = {.Bleeds},
		behaviors         = {.Wander, .Hop},
		on_hit_damage     = 1,
		texture           = texture_load("assets/textures/bunny_50x48.png"),
		initial_animation = "idle",
		hit_response      = .Knockback,
		hit_duration      = 0.25,
	}

	if jumper, jumper_ok := &gs.entity_definitions["Jumper"]; jumper_ok {
		jumper.animations["idle"] = Animation {
			size = {50, 48},
			offset = {16, 32},
			offset_flipped = {16, 32},
			time = 1,
		}
		jumper.animations["hop"] = Animation {
			size   = {50, 48},
			offset = {16, 32},
			offset_flipped = {16, 32},
			start  = 0,
			end    = 2,
			time   = 0.075,
			flags  = {},
		}

		append(&jumper.drops, Drop{type = .Lucky_Foot, chance = 1, range = {1, 2}})
	}

	gs.entity_definitions["Charger"] = Entity_Definition {
		collider_size     = {32, 12},
		hitbox            = {3, 0, 26, 12},
		hurtbox           = {-2, -8, 36, 20},
		health            = 3,
		move_speed        = 25,
		flags             = {.Bleeds},
		behaviors         = {.Walk, .Flip_At_Wall, .Flip_At_Edge, .Charge_At_Player},
		on_hit_damage     = 2,
		texture           = texture_load("assets/textures/pig_64x35.png"),
		initial_animation = "walk",
		hit_response      = .Stop,
		hit_duration      = 0.25,
	}

	if charger, charger_ok := &gs.entity_definitions["Charger"]; charger_ok {
		charger.animations["walk"] = Animation {
			size  = {64, 35},
			offset = {16, 23},
			offset_flipped = {16, 23},
			end   = 3,
			time  = 0.125,
			flags = {.Loop},
		}

		append(&charger.drops, Drop{type = .Strange_Bacon, chance = 0.5, range = {1, 3}})
		append(&charger.drops, Drop{type = .Dummy4, chance = 1, range = {1, 5000}})
	}

	gs.demon_boss_attack_texture = texture_load("assets/textures/demon_boss_240x192.png")
	gs.entity_definitions["Demon_Boss"] = Entity_Definition {
		collider_size     = {32, 64},
		hurtbox           = {2, 2, 28, 60},
		hitbox            = {8, 16, 16, 32},
		on_hit_damage     = 1,
		move_speed        = 35,
		health            = 30,
		debug_color       = rl.Color{255, 255, 0, 255},
		texture           = texture_load("assets/textures/demon_boss_160x144.png"),
		initial_animation = "fly",
		on_update         = demon_boss_on_update,
		flags             = {.Flying, .Kinematic, .Bleeds},
	}

	if demon_boss, demon_boss_ok := &gs.entity_definitions["Demon_Boss"]; demon_boss_ok {
		demon_boss.animations["fly"] = Animation {
			size           = {160, 144},
			offset         = {80, 48},
			offset_flipped = {48, 48},
			start          = 0,
			end            = 5,
			time           = 0.075,
			flags          = {.Loop},
		}

		demon_boss.animations["attack"] = Animation {
			size           = {240, 192},
			offset         = {80, 96},
			offset_flipped = {120, 96},
			start          = 0,
			end            = 10,
			time           = 0.075,
			flags          = {},
			on_finish      = demon_boss_on_finish_attack,
			texture        = gs.demon_boss_attack_texture,
		}

		if attack_anim, attack_anim_ok := &demon_boss.animations["attack"]; attack_anim_ok {
			append(
				&attack_anim.timed_events,
				Animation_Event{duration = 0.600, callback = demon_boss_breath_cb},
			)
			append(
				&attack_anim.timed_events,
				Animation_Event{duration = 0.675, callback = demon_boss_breath_cb},
			)
			append(
				&attack_anim.timed_events,
				Animation_Event{duration = 0.750, callback = demon_boss_breath_cb},
			)
		}

	}

	gs.entity_definitions["Orb"] = Entity_Definition {
		collider_size     = {16, 16},
		hitbox            = {4, 4, 8, 8},
		health            = 30,
		on_hit_damage     = 2,
		texture           = texture_load("assets/textures/orb_32x32.png"),
		initial_animation = "idle",
		flags             = {.Frozen, .Flying, .Immortal},
		on_hit_static     = fireball_on_hit_static,
	}

	if orb, orb_ok := &gs.entity_definitions["Orb"]; orb_ok {
		orb.animations["idle"] = Animation {
			size           = {32, 32},
			offset         = {8, 8},
			offset_flipped = {8, 8},
			time           = 1,
			tint           = {0, 255, 255, 255},
		}
	}

	gs.entity_definitions["Powerup:Dash"] = Entity_Definition {
		collider_size     = {16, 16},
		hitbox            = {0, 0, 16, 16},
		texture           = texture_load("assets/textures/powerup_16x16.png"),
		initial_animation = "idle",
		flags             = {.Flying},
		on_enter          = on_enter_powerup,
	}

	if dash, dash_ok := &gs.entity_definitions["Powerup:Dash"]; dash_ok {
		dash.animations["idle"] = Animation {
			size  = {16, 16},
			time  = 0.15,
			start = 0,
			end   = 7,
			flags = {.Loop}
		}
	}

	gs.entity_definitions["Grass"] = Entity_Definition {
		collider_size = 16,
		hitbox = {0, 0, 16, 16},
		texture = texture_load("assets/textures/grass.png"),
		initial_animation = "variant1",
		flags = {.Flying, .Kinematic},
		on_enter = on_enter_grass,
		shader = gs.grass_shader,
		on_death = on_death_grass,
	}

	if grass, grass_ok := &gs.entity_definitions["Grass"]; grass_ok {
		grass.animations["variant1"] = Animation {
			size = 16,
			time = 1,
			start = 1,
			end = 1,
		}

		grass.animations["variant2"] = Animation {
			size = 16,
			time = 1,
			start = 4,
			end = 4,
		}
	}

	gs.entity_definitions["Grass:Death"] = Entity_Definition {
		collider_size = 48,
		texture = texture_load("assets/textures/grass_48x48.png"),
		initial_animation = "idle",
		flags = {.Flying, .Immortal, .Kinematic},
		on_enter = on_enter_grass,
		shader = gs.grass_shader,
		on_death = on_death_grass,
	}

	if grass_death, grass_death_ok := &gs.entity_definitions["Grass:Death"]; grass_death_ok {
		grass_death.animations["idle"] = Animation {
			size = 48,
			time = 0.10,
			start = 0,
			end = 7,
			on_finish = on_finish_destroy_self,
		}
	}

	gs.scene = .Game

	editor_init()
}

on_enter_powerup :: proc(self_id, other_id: Entity_Id) {
	entity_destroy(self_id)
}

on_enter_grass :: proc(self_id, other_id: Entity_Id) {
}

on_death_grass :: proc(self: ^Entity, gs: ^Game_State) {
	entity_spawn("Grass:Death", {self.x, self.y} - {16, 32})
}

on_finish_destroy_self :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, self: ^Entity) {
	// entity_destroy(self)
	for &entity, i in gs.entities {
		if &entity == self {
			unordered_remove(&gs.entities, i)
			break
		}
	}
}

input_update :: proc() {
	for k, keybind in gs.config.keybinds {
		switch v in keybind.value {
		case rl.KeyboardKey:
			if rl.IsKeyPressed(v) {
				gs.input[k] = .Pressed
			} else if rl.IsKeyDown(v) {
				gs.input[k] = .Down
			} else if rl.IsKeyReleased(v) {
				gs.input[k] = .Released
			} else {
				gs.input[k] = .None
			}
		case rl.MouseButton:
			if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(v) {
				gs.input[k] = .Pressed
			} else if rl.IsMouseButtonDown(v) {
				gs.input[k] = .Down
			} else if rl.IsMouseButtonReleased(v) {
				gs.input[k] = .Released
			} else {
				gs.input[k] = .None
			}
		}
	}
}

game_update :: proc(gs: ^Game_State) {
	for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {
		fullscreen_toggle_handler()

		rl.UpdateMusicStream(gs.bgm)

		gs.this_frame_time = time.now()

		dt := rl.GetFrameTime()
		gs.delta_time = rl.GetFrameTime()
		gs.elapsed_time += gs.delta_time

		if gs.delta_time > gs.longest_frame_time {
			gs.longest_frame_time = gs.delta_time
		}

		input_update()

		if gs.input["pause"] == .Pressed {
			fmt.println("TODO: Open the menu, so we can quit!")
			gs.should_close = true
			return
		}

		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.F5) {
			gs.editor_enabled = !gs.editor_enabled
		}

		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.ONE) {
			append(&gs.screen_shakers, Screen_Shake{strength = 1, timer = 10})
		}

		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.TWO) {
			append(&gs.screen_shakers, Screen_Shake{strength = 1, timer = 3})
		}

		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.THREE) {
			append(&gs.screen_shakers, Screen_Shake{strength = 1, timer = 1})
		}

		// Make sure to get a new pointer every frame in case the entities
		// array is moved in memory
		player := entity_get(gs.player_id)

		if gs.editor_enabled {
			editor_update(gs, dt)
		} else {
			if gs.input["menu"] == .Pressed {
				gs.game_menu_state.menu_type += cast(Game_Menu_Type)1
				if gs.game_menu_state.menu_type == .Count {
					gs.game_menu_state.menu_type = .None
				}
			}

			player_update(gs, dt)
			entity_update(gs, dt)
			grass_update()
			physics_update(gs.entities[:], gs.colliders[:], gs.falling_logs[:], dt)
			behavior_update(gs.entities[:], gs.colliders[:], dt)
			particle_systems_update(gs)
			player_late_update(gs, dt)

			for &falling_log in gs.falling_logs {
				if falling_log.state == .Falling {
					falling_log.collider.y += dt * 600

					for collider in gs.colliders {
						if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(collider, falling_log.collider) {
							if collider.y <= falling_log.collider.y + falling_log.collider.height {
								falling_log.state = .Settled
								recreate_colliders(
									gs.level.pos,
									&gs.colliders,
									gs.falling_logs[:],
									gs.level.tiles[:],
								)
								break
							}
						}
					}

					for entity, i in gs.entities {
						if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(entity.collider, falling_log.collider) {
							entity_damage(Entity_Id(i), 999)
						}
					}
				}
			}

			// Update Camera
			{
				render_half_size := Vec2{RENDER_WIDTH, RENDER_HEIGHT} / 2

				target_x := player.x - render_half_size.x
				gs.camera.target.x = gs.camera.target.x + (target_x - gs.camera.target.x) * 0.1

				if .Grounded in player.flags {
					target_y := player.y + player.height / 2 - render_half_size.y
					gs.camera.target.y = gs.camera.target.y + (target_y - gs.camera.target.y) * 0.1
				} else {
					screen_pos_upper := rl.GetWorldToScreen2D({player.x + player.width * 0.5, player.y}, gs.camera) / gs.camera.zoom
					screen_pos_lower := rl.GetWorldToScreen2D({player.x + player.width * 0.5, player.y + player.height}, gs.camera) / gs.camera.zoom

					is_above_threshold := screen_pos_upper.y < RENDER_HEIGHT * 0.2
					is_below_threshold := screen_pos_lower.y > RENDER_HEIGHT * 0.8

					if is_above_threshold || is_below_threshold {
						target_y := player.y - render_half_size.y
						gs.camera.target.y = gs.camera.target.y + (target_y - gs.camera.target.y) * 0.03
					}
				}

				// Clamp to edges
				if gs.camera.target.x < gs.level.pos.x {
					gs.camera.target.x = gs.level.pos.x
				}

				if gs.camera.target.y < gs.level.pos.y {
					gs.camera.target.y = gs.level.pos.y
				}

				if gs.camera.target.x + RENDER_WIDTH > gs.level.pos.x + gs.level.size.x {
					gs.camera.target.x = gs.level.pos.x + gs.level.size.x - RENDER_WIDTH
				}

				if gs.camera.target.y + RENDER_HEIGHT > gs.level.pos.y + gs.level.size.y {
					gs.camera.target.y = gs.level.pos.y + gs.level.size.y - RENDER_HEIGHT
				}

				// Accumulate magnitude
				screen_shake: Vec2

				#reverse for &shaker, i in gs.screen_shakers {
					if shaker.timer <= 0 {
						unordered_remove(&gs.screen_shakers, i)
					}

					screen_shake.x += rand.float32_range(-shaker.strength, shaker.strength)
					screen_shake.y += rand.float32_range(-shaker.strength, shaker.strength)

					shaker.timer -= gs.delta_time
				}

				gs.camera.target += screen_shake

				// Round to prevent gaps in tiles
				gs.camera.target = linalg.round(gs.camera.target)
			}

			if .Grounded in player.flags {
				pos := Vec2{player.x, player.y}
				size := Vec2{player.width, player.height}

				targets := make([dynamic]Rect, context.temp_allocator)
				for e, i in gs.entities {
					if Entity_Id(i) == gs.player_id do continue
					if .Dead not_in e.flags {
						append(&targets, e.collider)
					}
				}

				safety_check: {
					for spike in gs.level.spikes {
						if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(spike.collider, player.collider) {
							break safety_check
						}
					}

					_, hit_ground_left := raycast(pos + {0, size.y}, DOWN * 2, gs.colliders[:])
					if !hit_ground_left do break safety_check

					_, hit_ground_right := raycast(pos + size, DOWN * 2, gs.colliders[:])
					if !hit_ground_right do break safety_check

					_, hit_entity_left := raycast(pos, LEFT * TILE_SIZE, targets[:])
					if hit_entity_left do break safety_check

					_, hit_entity_right := raycast(
						pos + {size.x, 0},
						RIGHT * TILE_SIZE,
						targets[:],
					)
					if hit_entity_right do break safety_check

					gs.safe_position = pos
				}
			}
		}

		rl.BeginDrawing()
		rl.BeginMode2D(gs.camera)
		rl.ClearBackground(BG_COLOR)

		for rect in gs.colliders {
			rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(rect, 1, rl.ORANGE)
		}

		for rect in gs.colliders {
			rl.DrawRectangleRec(rect, {255, 255, 255, 40})
		}

		for tile in gs.level.bg_tiles {
			rl.DrawTextureRec(
				gs.textures[gs.bg_tileset.texture],
				{tile.src.x, tile.src.y, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE},
				tile.pos,
				rl.WHITE,
			)
		}

		for tile in gs.level.tiles {
			rl.DrawTextureRec(
				gs.textures[gs.main_tileset.texture],
				{tile.src.x, tile.src.y, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE},
				tile.pos,
				rl.WHITE,
			)
		}

		for checkpoint in gs.level.checkpoints {
			if gs.checkpoint_pos == checkpoint.pos - TILE_SIZE {
				rl.DrawTextureRec(gs.textures[gs.tileset_texture], {96, 320, 32, 32}, checkpoint.pos - TILE_SIZE, rl.WHITE)
			} else {
				rl.DrawTextureRec(gs.textures[gs.tileset_texture], {48, 320, 32, 32}, checkpoint.pos - TILE_SIZE, rl.WHITE)
			}
		}

		for e in gs.entities {
			if .Dead in e.flags do continue

			if e.texture > 0 {
				anim := e.definition.animations[e.current_anim_name]
				source := Rect {
					f32(e.current_anim_frame) * anim.size.x,
					f32(anim.row) * anim.size.y,
					anim.size.x,
					anim.size.y,
				}

				if .Left in e.flags {
					source.width = -source.width
				}
				offset := .Left in e.flags ? anim.offset_flipped : anim.offset
				texture_index := anim.texture == 0 ? e.texture : anim.texture
				tint := anim.tint == 0 ? rl.WHITE : anim.tint

				if e.shader.id > 0 {
					rl.BeginShaderMode(e.shader)
					rl.DrawTextureRec(gs.textures[texture_index], source, {e.x, e.y} - offset, tint)
					rl.EndShaderMode()
				} else {
					rl.DrawTextureRec(gs.textures[texture_index], source, {e.x, e.y} - offset, tint)
				}
			}

			if .Debug_Draw in e.flags && .Dead not_in e.flags {
				rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(e.collider, 1, e.debug_color)
			}
		}

		for spike in gs.level.spikes {
			pos := Vec2{spike.collider.x, spike.collider.y}
			#partial switch spike.facing {
			case .Up:
				pos.y -= SPIKE_DIFF
			case .Right:
				pos.x -= SPIKE_DIFF
			}
			rl.DrawTextureRec(gs.textures[gs.tileset_texture], {304, 320, 16, 16}, pos, rl.WHITE)
		}

		for falling_log in gs.falling_logs {
			center := rect_center(falling_log.collider)
			if falling_log.state == .Default {
				rope_pos := Vec2{center.x, center.y - falling_log.collider.height / 2}
				rl.DrawLineEx(rope_pos, rope_pos - {0, falling_log.rope_height}, 1, rl.BROWN)
			}
			rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(falling_log.collider, 1, rl.BROWN)
		}

		for item in gs.items {
			src := Rect{item.src.x, item.src.y, 16, 16}
			rl.DrawTextureRec(gs.textures[gs.item_texture], src, item.pos, rl.WHITE)
		}

		for p in gs.particles {
			pos := linalg.round(p.pos)
			color := p.color
			color.a = u8(f32(p.color.a) * (1 - p.transparency))
			rl.DrawRectangleV(pos, p.size, color)
		}

		rl.EndMode2D()

		if gs.debug_draw_enabled {
			for e in gs.entities {
				collider := rect_to_screen(e.collider, gs.camera)
				hitbox := rect_to_screen(e.hitbox, gs.camera)
				hurtbox := rect_to_screen(e.hurtbox, gs.camera)

				rl.DrawRectangleRec(hitbox, {255, 0, 0, 60})
				rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(hurtbox, 1, rl.YELLOW)
				rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(collider, 1, rl.GREEN)
			}

			debug_draw_rect(gs.safe_position, Vec2{TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE * 1.5}, 1, rl.Color{0, 255, 255, 80}, false)

			for power_up in gs.level.power_up_spawns {
				rect := rect_to_screen({power_up.pos.x, power_up.pos.y, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE}, gs.camera)
				if power_up.type in gs.save_data.collected_power_ups {
					rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(rect, 1, rl.GOLD)
					rl.DrawTextEx(gs.font_18, fmt.ctprintf("%s (collected)", power_up.type), {rect.x, rect.y - 18}, 18, 0, rl.WHITE)
				} else {
					rl.DrawRectangleRec(rect, rl.GOLD)
					rl.DrawTextEx(gs.font_18, fmt.ctprintf("%s", power_up.type), {rect.x, rect.y - 18}, 18, 0, rl.WHITE)
				}
			}

			for s in gs.debug_shapes {
				switch v in s {
				case Debug_Line:
					rl.DrawLineEx(
						rl.GetWorldToScreen2D(v.start, gs.camera),
						rl.GetWorldToScreen2D(v.end, gs.camera),
						v.thickness,
						v.color
					)
				case Debug_Rect:
					pos := rl.GetWorldToScreen2D(v.pos, gs.camera)
					rect := rect_scale({pos.x, pos.y, v.size.x, v.size.y}, gs.camera.zoom)
					if v.filled {
						rl.DrawRectangleRec(rect, v.color)
					} else {
						rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(rect, v.thickness, v.color)
					}
				case Debug_Circle:
					pos := rl.GetWorldToScreen2D(v.pos, gs.camera)
					if v.filled {
						rl.DrawCircleV(pos, v.radius * gs.camera.zoom, v.color)
					} else {
						rl.DrawCircleLinesV(pos, v.radius * gs.camera.zoom, v.color)
					}
				}
			}

		}

		rl.BeginMode2D(gs.ui_camera)

		// Player health
		{
			full_hearts := player.health / 2
			has_half_heart := f32(player.health) / 2 > f32(full_hearts)
			// Integer division truncates towards zero.
			// 5 / 2 = 2
			// -5 / 2 = -2
			empty_hearts := math.ceil(f32(player.max_health - player.health) / 2)

			x := f32(16)

			for _ in 0 ..< full_hearts {
				rl.DrawTextureRec(
					gs.textures[gs.tileset_texture],
					{336, 176, 16, 16},
					{x, 16},
					rl.WHITE,
				)
				x += 16
			}

			if has_half_heart {
				rl.DrawTextureRec(
					gs.textures[gs.tileset_texture],
					{336, 144, 16, 16},
					{x, 16},
					rl.WHITE,
				)
				x += 16
			}

			for _ in 0 ..< empty_hearts {
				rl.DrawTextureRec(
					gs.textures[gs.tileset_texture],
					{336, 112, 16, 16},
					{x, 16},
					rl.WHITE,
				)
				x += 16
			}
		}

		// Inventory
		switch gs.game_menu_state.menu_type {
		case .None, .Count:
		case .Inventory:
			// Background
			rect := INGAME_UI_BG_RECT
			rl.DrawRectangleRec(rect, INGAME_UI_BG_COLOR)

			pos := Vec2{40, 40}

			text: cstring = "Inventory"
			font_size := f32(14)
			text_size := rl.MeasureTextEx(gs.font_48, text, font_size, 0)

			rl.DrawTextEx(
				gs.font_48,
				text,
				{pos.x + 24 * 4 - text_size.x / 2 - 4, 20},
				font_size,
				0,
				rl.WHITE,
			)

			// Items
			for slot, i in gs.inventory {
				src := Rect{slot.src.x, slot.src.y, 16, 16}
				rl.DrawTextureRec(gs.textures[gs.item_texture], src, pos, rl.WHITE)

				if slot.count > 1 {
					rl.DrawTextEx(
						gs.font_48,
						fmt.ctprintf("%d", slot.count),
						pos + 12,
						10,
						0,
						rl.WHITE,
					)
				}
				if (i + 1) % 8 == 0 {
					pos.y += 24
					pos.x = 16
				}

				pos.x += 24
			}
		case .Map:
			// Background
			rect := INGAME_UI_BG_RECT
			rl.DrawRectangleRec(rect, INGAME_UI_BG_COLOR)

			player_tile_pos_x := (int(player.x) / MAP_SCALE) * MAP_SCALE
			player_tile_pos_y := (int(player.y) / MAP_SCALE) * MAP_SCALE

			map_offset := Vec2{f32(player_tile_pos_x), f32(player_tile_pos_y)}

			for id in gs.save_data.visited_level_ids {
				level := level_from_id(gs.levels[:], id)
				if level == nil {
					continue
				}

				base_pos := level.pos
				base_pos -= map_offset
				base_pos = linalg.floor(base_pos / 16)
				base_pos += Vec2{RENDER_WIDTH, RENDER_HEIGHT} / 2

				size := level.size / 16

				bg_color := id == gs.level.id ? MAP_COLOR_CURRENT_LEVEL : MAP_COLOR_OTHER_LEVEL

				rl.DrawRectangleV(base_pos, size, bg_color)

				rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(
					{base_pos.x, base_pos.y, size.x, size.y},
					1,
					MAP_COLOR_LEVEL_BORDER,
				)

				for tile in level.tiles {
					rel_tile_pos := Vec2 {
						(tile.pos.x - level.pos.x) / 16,
						(tile.pos.y - level.pos.y) / 16,
					}
					tile_pos := linalg.round(base_pos + rel_tile_pos)
					tile_size :: f32(TILE_SIZE) / 16
					color := id == gs.level.id ? MAP_COLOR_SOLID : MAP_COLOR_SOLID_OTHER
					rl.DrawRectangleV(tile_pos, tile_size, color)
				}
			}

			player_pos := Vec2{RENDER_WIDTH, RENDER_HEIGHT} / 2
			player_size :: 4
			rl.DrawRectangleV(player_pos, player_size, MAP_COLOR_PLAYER)
		}

		rl.EndMode2D()

		if gs.editor_enabled {
			editor_draw(gs)
		}

		rl.DrawFPS(8, 8)

		rl.EndDrawing()

		clear(&gs.debug_shapes)
		free_all(context.temp_allocator)
	}
}

main :: proc() {
	level_on_enter_map["demon_boss_init"] = demon_boss_init
	level_on_enter_map["some_other_init"] = some_other_init
	level_on_enter_map["yet_other_init"] = yet_other_init
	level_on_enter_map["and_other_init"] = and_other_init

	gs = new(Game_State)
	gs.should_close = false
	gs.debug_draw_enabled = false

	// First texture slot is not available so we can easily assume all code paths work
	// And test against zero index instead of some nil
	append(&gs.textures, rl.Texture{})

	rl.InitWindow(RENDER_WIDTH, RENDER_HEIGHT, "Program Video Games!")
	rl.InitAudioDevice()

	rl.SetExitKey(.KEY_NULL)

	// Load config after window opens to gain access to monitor dimensions
	config_load()

	flags := rl.ConfigFlags{}

	if gs.config.display.vsync {
		flags += {.VSYNC_HINT}
	} else if gs.config.display.limit_fps {
		rl.SetTargetFPS(gs.config.display.target_fps)
	}

	monitor := rl.GetCurrentMonitor()
	monitor_width := rl.GetMonitorWidth(monitor)
	monitor_height := rl.GetMonitorHeight(monitor)

	switch gs.config.display.window_mode {
	case .Fullscreen:
		if gs.config.display.fullscreen_is_borderless_windowed {
			flags += {.BORDERLESS_WINDOWED_MODE}
		} else {
			flags += {.FULLSCREEN_MODE}
		}
		gs.config.display.width = rl.GetMonitorWidth(monitor)
		gs.config.display.height = rl.GetMonitorHeight(monitor)
	case .Windowed:
		rl.SetWindowPosition((monitor_width - gs.config.display.width) / 2, (monitor_height - gs.config.display.height) / 2)
	}

	rl.SetWindowSize(gs.config.display.width, gs.config.display.height)

	rl.SetWindowState(flags)

	set_resolution_values()

	gs.font_18 = rl.LoadFontEx("assets/fonts/Gogh-ExtraBold.ttf", 18, nil, 256)
	gs.font_48 = rl.LoadFontEx("assets/fonts/Gogh-ExtraBold.ttf", 48, nil, 256)
	gs.font_64 = rl.LoadFontEx("assets/fonts/Gogh-ExtraBold.ttf", 64, nil, 256)

	gs.tileset_texture = texture_load("assets/textures/tileset.png")
	gs.grass_texture = texture_load("assets/textures/grass.png")

	gs.main_tileset = make_main_tileset()
	gs.bg_tileset = make_bg_tileset()
	gs.mid_tileset = make_mid_tileset()

	gs.grass_shader = rl.LoadShader("", "shaders/grass.frag.glsl")

	world_data_load()

	gs.camera = rl.Camera2D {
		zoom = gs.scale,
	}
	gs.ui_camera = rl.Camera2D {
		zoom = gs.scale,
	}

	// Check for savefiles
	{
		curr_path := os.get_current_directory(context.temp_allocator)
		save_dir_path := fmt.tprintf("%s/saves", curr_path)
		save_dir, err := os.open(save_dir_path)
		if err == .Not_Exist {
			make_err := os.make_directory(save_dir_path)
			save_dir, err = os.open(save_dir_path)

			if make_err != nil || err != nil {
				panic("Could not create save directory")
			}
		}

		files, read_dir_err := os.read_dir(save_dir, 0, context.temp_allocator)
		if read_dir_err != nil {
			panic("Failed to read saves directory")
		}

		for file in files {
			save_data, ok := savefile_load(file.fullpath)
			if ok {
				gs.main_menu_state.save_slots[save_data.slot] = save_data
			}
		}
	}

	main_menu_init()

	for !gs.should_close {
		switch gs.scene {
		case .Main_Menu:
			main_menu_update(gs)
		case .Game:
			game_update(gs)
		}
	}
}




================================================
File: src/main_menu.odin
================================================
package main

import "core:fmt"
import "core:time"
import "core:strings"

import rl "vendor:raylib"

main_menu_init :: proc() {
	if rl.IsRenderTextureValid(gs.main_menu_state.save_texture) {
		rl.UnloadRenderTexture(gs.main_menu_state.save_texture)
	}

	width := i32(gs.save_panel_width)
	height := SAVE_SLOTS * gs.save_item_height
	gs.main_menu_state.save_texture = rl.LoadRenderTexture(width, i32(height))
}

main_menu_update :: proc(gs: ^Game_State) {
	for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {
		fullscreen_toggle_handler()

		rl.BeginDrawing()
		rl.ClearBackground(BG_COLOR_MAIN_MENU)

		row_height := gs.scale * 24
		font_size := gs.scale * 16

		switch gs.main_menu_state.menu_type {
		case .Default:
			title_font_size := gs.scale * 32

			center := Vec2{
				f32(gs.config.display.width),
				f32(gs.config.display.height),
			} / 2
			title_text: cstring = "METROIDVANIA"
			title_text_size := rl.MeasureTextEx(gs.font_18, title_text, title_font_size, 4)

			// Draw Title
			rl.DrawTextEx(
				gs.font_64,
				title_text,
				{center.x - title_text_size.x / 2, center.y / 2},
				title_font_size,
				4,
				rl.WHITE,
			)

			if main_menu_item_draw("Play", center, font_size) {
				gs.main_menu_state.menu_type = .Select_Save_Slot
			}

			if main_menu_item_draw("Settings", center + {0, row_height}, font_size) {
				gs.main_menu_state.menu_type = .Settings
			}

			if main_menu_item_draw("Quit", center + {0, row_height * 2}, font_size) {
				rl.CloseWindow()
				return
			}
		case .Select_Save_Slot:
			// To simulate a scrolling box, we are rendering to a different texture
			target := gs.main_menu_state.save_texture

			// This is the position of the scrolling box
			panel_pos := Vec2{
				(f32(gs.config.display.width) - gs.save_panel_width) / 2,
				 f32(gs.config.display.height) / 2 - gs.save_panel_height / 2,
			}

			mouse_wheel_move := rl.GetMouseWheelMove()

			// This offset is used to draw the correct part of the texture into the box
			gs.main_menu_state.save_list_scroll_offset = clamp(
				gs.main_menu_state.save_list_scroll_offset + mouse_wheel_move * SCROLL_SPEED,
				gs.save_panel_height - gs.save_item_height * SAVE_SLOTS,
				0,
			)

			// Start drawing to the texture
			rl.BeginTextureMode(target)
			rl.ClearBackground(BG_COLOR_MAIN_MENU)

			for save_data, i in gs.main_menu_state.save_slots {
				// We always have SAVE_SLOTS amount of save slots
				// So we check if the seconds_played is > 0 to determine if the slot is taken
				if save_data.seconds_played > 0 {

					// Save file exists, pass in location and seconds_played
					if load_game_item_draw(
						i,
						panel_pos,
						gs.main_menu_state.save_list_scroll_offset,
						save_data.location,
						save_data.seconds_played,
					) {
						gs.save_data = save_data
						game_init(gs)

						// If level doesn't exist, replace it with FIRST_LEVEL_ID
						// NOTE: Else break save games during development

						spawn_pos := Vec2{}
						level := level_from_id(gs.levels[:], gs.save_data.level_id)
						if level == nil {
							gs.save_data.level_id = FIRST_LEVEL_ID
						} else {
							// Spawn at checkpoint
							spawn_pos = pos_from_coords(gs.save_data.checkpoint_coords)
							gs.checkpoint_pos = spawn_pos - TILE_SIZE
							gs.checkpoint_level_id = gs.save_data.level_id
							gs.safe_position = gs.checkpoint_pos
						}

						level_load(gs, gs.save_data.level_id, spawn_pos)

					}
				} else {
					// We are starting a new game
					if load_game_item_draw(
						i,
						panel_pos,
						gs.main_menu_state.save_list_scroll_offset,
					) {
						game_init(gs)

						gs.save_data.slot = i
						gs.save_data.version.major = VERSION_MAJOR
						gs.save_data.version.minor = VERSION_MINOR
						gs.save_data.version.patch = VERSION_PATCH

						level_load(gs, FIRST_LEVEL_ID)
					}
				}
			}

			rl.EndTextureMode()

			// We finished drawing to the scrolling box
			// Now we draw the box onto the screen at the correct location

			rl.DrawTextureRec(
				gs.main_menu_state.save_texture.texture,
				Rect {
					0,
					gs.main_menu_state.save_list_scroll_offset - gs.save_panel_height,
					gs.save_panel_width,
					-gs.save_panel_height,
				},
				panel_pos,
				rl.WHITE,
			)

			{
				text :: "Back"
				size := rl.MeasureTextEx(gs.font_48, text, font_size, 0)
				if main_menu_item_draw(text, {8 * gs.scale + size.x / 2, f32(gs.config.display.height) - row_height}, font_size) {
					gs.main_menu_state.menu_type = .Default
				}
			}
		case .Settings:
			y := f32(gs.config.display.height) * 0.25

			draw_binding_row(y, row_height, "UP", "up"); y += row_height
			draw_binding_row(y, row_height, "LEFT", "left"); y += row_height
			draw_binding_row(y, row_height, "DOWN", "down"); y += row_height
			draw_binding_row(y, row_height, "RIGHT", "right"); y += row_height
			y += row_height
			draw_binding_row(y, row_height, "JUMP", "jump"); y += row_height
			draw_binding_row(y, row_height, "ATTACK", "attack"); y += row_height
			draw_binding_row(y, row_height, "DASH", "dash"); y += row_height

			{
				cancel_text :: "Cancel"
				cancel_size := rl.MeasureTextEx(gs.font_48, cancel_text, font_size, 0)
				if main_menu_item_draw(cancel_text, {8 * gs.scale + cancel_size.x / 2, f32(gs.config.display.height) - row_height}, font_size) {
					gs.main_menu_state.menu_type = .Default

					// Reset menu keybinds to saved ones
					for k, v in gs.config.keybinds {
						gs.main_menu_state.keybinds[k] = v
					}
				}

				reset_text :: "Reset"
				reset_size := rl.MeasureTextEx(gs.font_48, reset_text, font_size, 0)
				if main_menu_item_draw(reset_text, {f32(gs.config.display.width) / 2 - reset_size.x / 2, f32(gs.config.display.height) - row_height}, font_size) {
					for k, v in default_keybinds {
						gs.main_menu_state.keybinds[k] = v
					}
				}

				save_text :: "Save"
				save_size := rl.MeasureTextEx(gs.font_48, save_text, font_size, 0)
				if main_menu_item_draw(save_text, {f32(gs.config.display.width) - (8 * gs.scale + save_size.x / 2), f32(gs.config.display.height) - row_height}, font_size) {
					gs.main_menu_state.menu_type = .Default

					for k, v in gs.main_menu_state.keybinds {
						gs.config.keybinds[k] = v
					}

					config_save()
				}
			}

			draw_binding_row :: proc(y, row_height: f32, label, action: string) -> bool {
				upper_action := strings.to_upper(action, context.temp_allocator)
				font_size := gs.scale * 16
				action_text := fmt.ctprintf(upper_action)
				binding := gs.main_menu_state.keybinds[action]
				binding_text := fmt.ctprintf("%v", binding)

				color := rl.WHITE

				clicked := false
				binding_done := false

				if gs.main_menu_state.current_binding_action == action {
					binding_text = "Press Key to Bind (Esc to Cancel)"

					key := rl.GetKeyPressed()

					if key == .ESCAPE {
						binding_done = true
					} else if key != .KEY_NULL {
						gs.main_menu_state.keybinds[action] = {key, .Keyboard_Key}
						binding_done = true
					} else {
						for button in rl.MouseButton {
							if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(button) {
								gs.main_menu_state.keybinds[action] = {button, .Mouse_Button}
								binding_done = true
								break
							}
						}
					}

					if binding_done {
						gs.main_menu_state.current_binding_value = {.KEY_NULL, .Keyboard_Key}
						gs.main_menu_state.current_binding_action = ""
					}
				} else {
					switch v in binding.value {
					case rl.KeyboardKey:
						binding_text = fmt.ctprintf("%v (Keyboard)", v)
					case rl.MouseButton:
						binding_text = fmt.ctprintf("%v (Mouse)", v)
					}
				}

				binding = gs.main_menu_state.keybinds[action]

				if !binding_done {
					if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), rect_from_pos_size({0, y}, {f32(gs.config.display.width), row_height})) {
						color = rl.YELLOW

						if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) {
							clicked = true
							gs.main_menu_state.current_binding_action = action
						}
					}

					count := 0
					for _, v in gs.main_menu_state.keybinds {
						if v.type == binding.type {
							if v.value == binding.value {
								count += 1
							}
						}
					}

					if count > 1 {
						color = rl.RED
					}
				}

				binding_text_size := rl.MeasureTextEx(gs.font_64, binding_text, font_size, 0)

				margin := f32(gs.config.display.width) * 0.125
				left_x := margin
				right_x := f32(gs.config.display.width) - margin - binding_text_size.x

				rl.DrawTextEx(gs.font_64, action_text,  {left_x, y}, font_size, 0, color)
				rl.DrawTextEx(gs.font_64, binding_text, {right_x, y}, font_size, 0, color)

				return clicked
			}
		}

		rl.EndDrawing()

		// gs.scene is set when we load_level
		// We need to make sure we end texture and drawing modes
		// Then we can return to change scene

		if gs.scene != .Main_Menu {
			return
		}
	}
}

load_game_item_draw :: proc(
	slot: int,
	panel_pos: Vec2,
	offset: f32,
	location: string = "",
	time_played: f64 = 0,
) -> (
	pressed: bool,
) {
	text: cstring
	if time_played == 0 {
		text = "New Game"
	} else {
		dur := time.Duration(i64(time_played * 1000 * 1000 * 1000))
		buf: [time.MIN_HMS_LEN]u8
		time_played_str := time.to_string_hms(dur, buf[:])
		text = fmt.ctprintf("%d - %s, %s", slot + 1, location, time_played_str)
	}

	pos := Vec2{0, f32(slot) * gs.save_item_height}
	mouse_pos := rl.GetMousePosition()

	screen_pos := panel_pos + {0, pos.y + offset}

	if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(
		mouse_pos,
		{screen_pos.x, screen_pos.y, gs.save_panel_width, gs.save_item_height},
	) {
		rl.DrawTextEx(gs.font_48, text, pos, gs.scale * 16, 0, rl.YELLOW)
		if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) {
			pressed = true
		}
	} else {
		rl.DrawTextEx(gs.font_48, text, pos, gs.scale * 16, 0, rl.WHITE)
	}

	return
}

main_menu_item_draw :: proc(
	text: cstring,
	pos: Vec2,
	font_size: f32,
	color := rl.WHITE,
	hover_color := rl.YELLOW,
) -> (
	pressed: bool,
) {
	pos := pos
	text_size := rl.MeasureTextEx(gs.font_48, text, font_size, 0)
	pos.x -= text_size.x / 2
	rect := Rect{pos.x, pos.y, text_size.x, text_size.y}

	if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), rect) {
		rl.DrawTextEx(gs.font_48, text, pos, font_size, 0, hover_color)
		if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) {
			pressed = true
		}
	} else {
		rl.DrawTextEx(gs.font_48, text, pos, font_size, 0, color)
	}

	return
}



================================================
File: src/particle.odin
================================================
package main

import "core:math"
import "core:math/linalg"
import "core:math/rand"

import rl "vendor:raylib"

PARTICLE_DRAG :: 0.99
PARTICLE_MIN_VELOCITY_LENGTH :: 0.1

Particle :: struct {
	pos:               Vec2,
	velocity:          Vec2,
	color:             rl.Color,
	lifetime_timer:    f32,
	size:              f32,
	size_step:         f32,
	transparency_step: f32,
	transparency:      f32,
	bounce_loss:       f32,
}

Range_f32 :: [2]f32
Range_int :: [2]int

Particle_System_Options :: struct {
	pos:           Vec2,
	frequency:     f32,
	lifetime:      f32,
	emission_rate: f32,
	rotation:      Range_f32,
	width:         f32,

	// particle options
	particle:      struct {
		lifetime:     Range_f32,
		initial_size: Range_int,
		scale:        Range_f32,
		transparency: Range_f32, // Used transparency because 0 == visible
		velocity:     Range_f32,
		bounce_loss:  Range_f32,
		color:        rl.Color,
		variance:     f32,
	},
}

Particle_System :: struct {
	using options:  Particle_System_Options,

	// runtime fields
	lifetime_timer: f32, // Lifetime remaining in seconds
	emission_timer: f32,
}

particle_system_spawn :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, opts: Particle_System_Options) {
	ps: Particle_System
	ps.options = opts

	ps.lifetime_timer = opts.lifetime
	append(&gs.particle_systems, ps)
}

particle_systems_update :: proc(gs: ^Game_State) {
	#reverse for &ps, i in gs.particle_systems {
		ps.emission_timer += gs.delta_time

		if ps.emission_timer >= ps.frequency {
			ps.emission_timer = 0
			for _ in 0 ..< ps.emission_rate {
				current_rotation: f32
				radians: f32
				velocity: Vec2
				lifetime: f32
				size_f32: f32
				size_step: f32
				transparency_step: f32
				pos: Vec2

				velocity.y = rand.float32_range(ps.particle.velocity.x, ps.particle.velocity.y)

				if ps.rotation.x != 0 || ps.rotation.y != 0 {
					progress := 1 - (ps.lifetime_timer / ps.lifetime)
					current_rotation = linalg.lerp(ps.rotation.x, ps.rotation.y, progress)
					variance := rand.float32_range(-ps.particle.variance / 2, ps.particle.variance / 2)
					radians = math.to_radians(current_rotation + variance)

					x, y := velocity.x, velocity.y
					velocity.x = x * math.cos(radians) - y * math.sin(radians)
					velocity.y = x * math.sin(radians) + y * math.cos(radians)
				}
				lifetime = rand.float32_range(ps.particle.lifetime.x, ps.particle.lifetime.y)

				// Size round to big pixel size (camera zoom)
				size := rand.int_max(ps.particle.initial_size.y) + ps.particle.initial_size.x
				size_f32 = f32(size) * gs.camera.zoom

				// NOTE: To make it easier, assume we are always hitting TARGET_FPS
				size_step = (ps.particle.scale.y - ps.particle.scale.x) / lifetime / TARGET_FPS

				transparency_step = (ps.particle.transparency.y - ps.particle.transparency.x) / lifetime / TARGET_FPS

				pos = ps.pos
				// Position based on rotated line
				if ps.width > 0 {
					distance := rand.float32_range(-ps.width / 2, ps.width / 2)
					pos.x = pos.x + distance * math.cos(radians)
					pos.y = pos.y + distance * math.sin(radians)
				}
				append(
					&gs.particles,
					Particle {
						pos = pos,
						velocity = velocity,
						color = ps.particle.color,
						lifetime_timer = lifetime,
						size = size_f32,
						size_step = size_step,
						transparency_step = transparency_step,
					},
				)
			}

			ps.lifetime_timer -= gs.delta_time
			if ps.lifetime_timer <= 0 {
				unordered_remove(&gs.particle_systems, i)
			}
		}
	}

	#reverse for &p, i in gs.particles {
		p.lifetime_timer -= gs.delta_time
		if p.lifetime_timer <= 0 {
			unordered_remove_soa(&gs.particles, i)
			continue
		}

		p.size += p.size_step
		p.pos -= p.size_step / 2

		p.transparency += p.transparency_step

		p.velocity.y += GRAVITY * gs.delta_time
		p.velocity *= PARTICLE_DRAG

		if p.velocity.y > TERMINAL_VELOCITY {
			p.velocity.y = TERMINAL_VELOCITY
		}

		if linalg.length(p.velocity) < PARTICLE_MIN_VELOCITY_LENGTH {
			p.velocity = 0
			// Skip expensive calculations when not moving
			continue
		}

		delta := p.velocity * gs.delta_time
		rect := Rect{p.pos.x, p.pos.y, p.size, p.size}
		next_pos, normal, did_hit := physics_sweep_aabbs(rect, gs.colliders[:], delta)
		if did_hit {
			if normal.x != 0 {
				p.velocity.x *= -1
			} else {
				p.velocity.y *= -1
			}
			p.velocity *= p.bounce_loss
		}

		p.pos = next_pos
	}
}



================================================
File: src/physics.odin
================================================
package main

import "core:math"
import "core:time"

import rl "vendor:raylib"

COLLISION_EPSILON :: 0.01
MOVEMENT_EPSILON :: 0.01

raycast :: proc(
	start, magnitude: Vec2,
	targets: []Rect,
	allocator := context.temp_allocator,
) -> (
	hits: []Vec2,
	ok: bool,
) {
	hit_store := make([dynamic]Vec2, allocator)

	for t in targets {
		p, q, r, s: Vec2 = {t.x, t.y}, {t.x, t.y + t.height}, {t.x + t.width, t.y + t.height}, {t.x + t.width, t.y}
		lines := [4][2]Vec2{{p, q}, {q, r}, {r, s}, {s, p}}
		for line in lines {
			point: Vec2
			if rl.CheckCollisionLines(start, start + magnitude, line[0], line[1], &point) {
				append(&hit_store, point)
			}
		}

		color := len(hit_store) > 0 ? rl.GREEN : rl.YELLOW
		debug_draw_line(start, start + magnitude, 1, color)
	}

	return hit_store[:], len(hit_store) > 0
}

physics_update :: proc(entities: []Entity, static_colliders: []Rect, logs: []Falling_Log, dt: f32) {
	dt := dt

	expected_dt := 1 / f32(gs.config.display.target_fps)
	if dt > expected_dt * 2 {
		// @Dylan:
		// Frame rate is too low
		// Due to the collision system being simple overlap checks for entities, this may cause tunneling
		// We'll skip some frames to keep the game stable 
		// This is mostly an issue when using alt-enter to full-screen the program
		// Untested on very low-end hardware
		// My laptop is intentionally low-end (t480s) and still runs this game at 60 FPS
		dt = expected_dt
	}

	for &entity, e_id in entities {
		entity_id := Entity_Id(e_id)

		if .Dead in entity.flags do continue

		if .Kinematic not_in entity.flags {
			for _ in 0 ..< PHYSICS_ITERATIONS {
				// The fact we have to write exceptions for the player here
				// means the player may have been better off being it's own
				// type. i.e. not an Entity
				is_player := entity_id == gs.player_id
				player_is_dashing := gs.player_movement_state == .Dash

				step := dt / PHYSICS_ITERATIONS

				if !(is_player && player_is_dashing) {
					if .Flying not_in entity.flags {
						entity.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt
						if entity.vel.y > TERMINAL_VELOCITY {
							entity.vel.y = TERMINAL_VELOCITY
						}
					}
				}

				did_hit := false
				hit_pos: Vec2

				// Y axis
				entity.y += entity.vel.y * step
				entity.flags -= {.Grounded}
				for static in static_colliders {
					if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(entity.collider, static) {
						resolve_entity_vs_static_y(&entity, static)
						did_hit = true
						hit_pos = {entity.x, entity.y}
						break
					}
				}
				for log in logs {
					if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(entity.collider, log.collider) {
						resolve_entity_vs_static_y(&entity, log.collider)
						did_hit = true
						hit_pos = {entity.x, entity.y}
						break
					}
				}

				// X axis
				entity.x += entity.vel.x * step
				for static in static_colliders {
					if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(entity.collider, static) {
						resolve_entity_vs_static_x(&entity, static)
						did_hit = true
						hit_pos = {entity.x, entity.y}
						break
					}
				}
				for log in logs {
					if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(entity.collider, log.collider) {
						resolve_entity_vs_static_x(&entity, log.collider)
						did_hit = true
						hit_pos = {entity.x, entity.y}
						break
					}
				}

				if did_hit && entity.on_hit_static != nil {
					entity.on_hit_static(&entity, gs, hit_pos, dt)
				}
			}
		}

		entity.hitbox.x = entity.x + entity.definition.hitbox.x
		entity.hitbox.y = entity.y + entity.definition.hitbox.y
		entity.hurtbox.x = entity.x + entity.definition.hurtbox.x
		entity.hurtbox.y = entity.y + entity.definition.hurtbox.y

		// Hitbox<->Hurtbox collisions
		// Enemies have a constant Hitbox around them
		for &other, o_id in entities {
			other_id := Entity_Id(o_id)
			if entity_id == other_id do continue
			if entity.hitbox.width == 0 && entity.hitbox.height == 0 do continue

			if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(entity.hitbox, other.hurtbox) {
				if entity_id not_in other.entity_ids {
					other.entity_ids[entity_id] = time.now()

					if other.on_enter != nil {
						other.on_enter(other_id, entity_id)
					}
				} else {
					if other.on_stay != nil {
						other.on_stay(other_id, entity_id)
					}
				}
			} else if entity_id in other.entity_ids {
				if other.on_exit != nil {
					other.on_exit(other_id, entity_id)
				}
				delete_key(&other.entity_ids, entity_id)
			}
		}
	}
}

// TODO: Either: Add callback to collisions
//       Or:     Make Player not an Entity (Like Demon Boss)
resolve_entity_vs_static_y :: proc(entity: ^Entity, static: Rect) {
	if entity.vel.y > 0 {
		entity.y = static.y - entity.height
		entity.flags += {.Grounded}
	} else {
		entity.y = static.y + static.height
		// Yet another case of special handling here
		if entity == entity_get(gs.player_id) {
			// Cancel the jump timer so we don't "bounce" in a 3-tall hallway
			gs.jump_timer = 0
		}
	}
	entity.vel.y = 0

}

resolve_entity_vs_static_x :: proc(entity: ^Entity, static: Rect) {
	if entity.vel.x > 0 {
		entity.x = static.x - entity.width
	} else {
		entity.x = static.x + static.width
	}
	entity.vel.x = 0
}

physics_moving_rect_vs_static :: proc(
	moving, static: Rect,
	vel: Vec2,
) -> (
	hit_time: f32,
	normal: Vec2,
	did_hit: bool,
) {
	if abs(vel.x) < MOVEMENT_EPSILON && abs(vel.y) < MOVEMENT_EPSILON {
		return 0, 0, rl.CheckCollisionRecs(moving, static)
	}

	if vel.x == 0 && (moving.x + moving.width < static.x || moving.x > static.x + static.width) {
		return
	}

	if vel.y == 0 && (moving.y + moving.height < static.y || moving.y > static.y + static.height) {
		return
	}

	expanded_size := rect_size(moving) + rect_size(static)
	dist := rect_center(static) - rect_center(moving)

	entry := (dist - expanded_size / 2) / vel
	exit := (dist + expanded_size / 2) / vel

	if vel.x < 0 do entry.x, exit.x = exit.x, entry.x
	if vel.y < 0 do entry.y, exit.y = exit.y, entry.y

	entry_time := max(entry.x, entry.y)
	exit_time := min(exit.x, exit.y)

	if entry_time > exit_time || entry_time > 1 || entry_time < 0 {
		return
	}

	if entry.x > entry.y {
		normal.x = -math.sign(vel.x)
	} else {
		normal.y = -math.sign(vel.y)
	}

	return entry_time, normal, true
}

physics_aabb_vs_aabb :: proc(a, b: Rect, vel: Vec2) -> (Direction, bool) {
	if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(a, b) {
		center_a := rect_center(a)
		center_b := rect_center(b)

		if abs(vel.x) > abs(vel.y) {
			if center_a.x < center_b.x {
				return .Left, true
			}
			return .Right, true
		} else {
			if center_a.y < center_b.y {
				return .Up, true
			}
			return .Down, true
		}
	}
	return {}, false
}

physics_sweep_aabbs :: proc(moving: Rect, static: []Rect, vel: Vec2) -> (pos: Vec2, normal: Vec2, ok: bool) {
	nearest_time := f32(2)

	for s in static {
		// First check simply
		if dir, is_overlapping := physics_aabb_vs_aabb(moving, s, vel); is_overlapping {
			switch dir {
			case .Up:
				return {moving.x, s.y - moving.height - COLLISION_EPSILON}, {0, -1}, true
			case .Right:
				return {s.x + s.width + COLLISION_EPSILON, moving.y}, {-1, 0}, true
			case .Down:
				return {moving.x, s.y + COLLISION_EPSILON}, {0, 1}, true
			case .Left:
				return {s.x - moving.width - COLLISION_EPSILON, moving.y}, {1, 0}, true
			}

			// Don't do expensive check until next check
			continue
		}

		if hit_time, norm, did_hit := physics_moving_rect_vs_static(moving, s, vel); did_hit {
			nearest_time = min(nearest_time, hit_time)
			normal = norm
		}
	}

	if nearest_time <= 1 {
		return {moving.x, moving.y} + vel * nearest_time, normal, true
	}

	return {moving.x, moving.y} + vel, normal, false
}



================================================
File: src/player.odin
================================================
package main

import "core:math/linalg"

import rl "vendor:raylib"

Player_Movement_State :: enum {
	Uncontrollable,
	Idle,
	Run,
	Jump,
	Fall,
	Dash,
	Attack_First,
	Attack_First_Recovery,
	Attack_Second,
	Attack_Second_Recovery,
}

COMBO_WINDOW_DURATION :: 0.3
EARLY_INPUT_WINDOW :: 0.2

player_update :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, dt: f32) {
	player := entity_get(gs.player_id)

	if player.health <= 0 {
		player_on_death(player, gs)
		return
	}

	menu_active := gs.game_menu_state.menu_type != .None

	attack_pressed := gs.input["attack"] == .Pressed

	input_dir: Vec2
	if !menu_active && gs.player_movement_state != .Uncontrollable {
		if gs.input["right"] == .Down || gs.input["right"] == .Pressed do input_dir.x += 1
		if gs.input["left"] == .Down || gs.input["left"] == .Pressed do input_dir.x -= 1
		if gs.input["down"] == .Down || gs.input["down"] == .Pressed do input_dir.y += 1
		if gs.input["up"] == .Down || gs.input["up"] == .Pressed do input_dir.y -= 1
	}
	input_dir = linalg.normalize0(input_dir)

	if gs.player_movement_state != .Dash {
		player.vel.x = input_dir.x * player.move_speed
	}

	if player.vel.x > 0 do player.flags -= {.Left}
	if player.vel.x < 0 do player.flags += {.Left}

	if gs.attack_recovery_timer > 0 {
		gs.attack_recovery_timer -= dt
		player.vel *= 0.5
	}

	if gs.dash_cooldown_timer > 0 {
		gs.dash_cooldown_timer -= dt
	}

	gs.jump_timer -= dt
	gs.coyote_timer -= dt
	gs.attack_cooldown_timer -= dt
	gs.combo_window_timer -= dt

	switch gs.player_movement_state {
	case .Uncontrollable:
		gs.safe_reset_timer -= dt
		if gs.safe_reset_timer <= 0 {
			switch_animation(player, "idle")
			gs.player_movement_state = .Idle
			player.vel.x = 0
			player.vel.y = 0
			player.x = gs.safe_position.x
			player.y = gs.safe_position.y
		}
	case .Attack_First:
		if attack_pressed && player.animation_timer <= EARLY_INPUT_WINDOW {
			gs.buffered_second_attack = true
		}

		if player.animation_timer <= 0 {
			gs.player_movement_state = .Idle
			gs.combo_window_timer = COMBO_WINDOW_DURATION
			switch_animation(player, "idle")

			if gs.buffered_second_attack {
				gs.player_movement_state = .Attack_Second
				switch_animation(player, "attack_2")
				gs.buffered_second_attack = false
			}
		}
	case .Attack_First_Recovery:
		if gs.combo_window_timer <= 0 {
			switch_animation(player, "idle")
			gs.player_movement_state = .Idle
		}

		try_run(gs, player)
		try_jump(gs, player)
		try_dash(gs, player, input_dir)
		try_attack(gs, player)
	case .Attack_Second:
		gs.combo_window_timer = 0

		if player.animation_timer <= 0 {
			gs.player_movement_state = .Idle
			switch_animation(player, "idle")
			gs.attack_cooldown_timer = ATTACK_COOLDOWN_DURATION
		}
	case .Attack_Second_Recovery:
		if gs.attack_cooldown_timer <= 0 {
			switch_animation(player, "idle")
			gs.player_movement_state = .Idle
		}

		try_run(gs, player)
		try_jump(gs, player)
		try_dash(gs, player, input_dir)
	case .Idle:
		if !menu_active {
			try_run(gs, player)
			try_jump(gs, player)
			try_attack(gs, player)
			try_activate_checkpoint(gs, player)
			try_dash(gs, player, input_dir)
		}
	case .Run:
		if input_dir.x == 0 {
			gs.player_movement_state = .Idle
			switch_animation(player, "idle")
		}

		if !menu_active {
			try_jump(gs, player)
			try_attack(gs, player)
			try_dash(gs, player, input_dir)
		}
	case .Jump:
		if gs.input["jump"] == .Released {
			player.vel.y *= 0.5
		}

		if player.vel.y >= 0 {
			gs.player_movement_state = .Fall
			player.current_anim_name = "fall"
			switch_animation(player, "fall")
		}

		if !menu_active {
			try_attack(gs, player)
			try_dash(gs, player, input_dir)
		}
	case .Fall:
		if .Grounded in player.flags {
			gs.player_movement_state = .Idle
			switch_animation(player, "idle")

			// Dust particles
			pos := Vec2{player.collider.x + player.collider.width / 2, player.collider.y + player.collider.height - 4}
			opts := Particle_System_Options {
				pos = pos,
				frequency = 0.001,
				lifetime = 0.001,
				emission_rate = 5,
				rotation = 180,
				width = 20,
				particle = {
					lifetime = {1, 3},
					initial_size = {1, 2},
					scale = 1,
					transparency = {0, 1},
					velocity = {50, 80},
					variance = 20,
					color = rl.BROWN,
				},
			}
			particle_system_spawn(gs, opts)
		}
		if !menu_active {
			try_attack(gs, player)
			try_jump(gs, player)
			try_dash(gs, player, input_dir)
		}
	case .Dash:
		if gs.dash_timer > 0 {
			gs.dash_timer -= dt
			if gs.dash_timer <= 0 {
				gs.dash_cooldown_timer = DASH_COOLDOWN
				gs.player_movement_state = .Fall
				switch_animation(player, "fall")
			}
		}
	}

	if gs.player_movement_state != .Uncontrollable {
		for spike in gs.level.spikes {
			if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(spike.collider, player.collider) {
				player.vel = {0, -500}
				gs.safe_reset_timer = PLAYER_SAFE_RESET_TIME
				gs.player_movement_state = .Uncontrollable
				switch_animation(player, "idle")
				entity_damage(gs.player_id, 1)

				// Don't hit more than 1 spike
				break
			}
		}
	}

	for power_up in gs.level.power_up_spawns {
		if power_up.type not_in gs.save_data.collected_power_ups {
			rect := rect_from_pos_size(power_up.pos, 16)
			if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(rect, player.collider) {
				gs.save_data.collected_power_ups += {power_up.type}
				savefile_save(gs.save_data)
				break
			}
		}
	}

	#reverse for item, i in gs.items {
		if linalg.length2(rect_center(player) - item.pos) < 256 {
			inventory_add(gs, item.type, 1)
			ordered_remove(&gs.items, i)
		}
	}
}

player_late_update :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, dt: f32) {
	player := entity_get(gs.player_id)

	// If we move outside the level, we are moving into another level!
	level_rect := rect_from_pos_size(gs.level.pos, gs.level.size)
	overlap := rl.GetCollisionRec(player.collider, level_rect)
	if overlap.width == 0 && overlap.height == 0 {
		for l in gs.levels {
			if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(player.collider, rect_from_pos_size(l.pos, l.size)) {
				overlap = rl.GetCollisionRec(player.collider, rect_from_pos_size(l.pos, l.size))
				level_load(gs, l.id, Vec2{overlap.x, overlap.y})
				break
			}
		}
	}
}

try_run :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, player: ^Entity) {
	if player.vel.x != 0 && .Grounded in player.flags {
		switch_animation(player, "run")
		gs.player_movement_state = .Run
	}
}

try_jump :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, player: ^Entity) {
	if gs.input["jump"] == .Pressed {
		gs.jump_timer = JUMP_TIME
	}

	if .Grounded in player.flags {
		gs.coyote_timer = COYOTE_TIME
	}

	if gs.player_movement_state != .Fall && gs.coyote_timer > 0 && gs.jump_timer > 0 {
		rl.PlaySound(gs.player_jump_sound)
		player.vel.y = -player.jump_force
		player.flags -= {.Grounded}
		switch_animation(player, "jump")
		gs.player_movement_state = .Jump

		pos := Vec2{player.collider.x + player.collider.width / 2, player.collider.y + player.collider.height - 4}
		opts := Particle_System_Options {
			pos = pos,
			frequency = 0.001,
			lifetime = 0.001,
			emission_rate = 10,
			rotation = 180,
			width = 20,
			particle = {
				lifetime = {1, 3},
				initial_size = {1, 2},
				scale = 1,
				transparency = {0, 1},
				velocity = {50, 80},
				variance = 20,
				color = rl.BROWN,
			},
		}
		particle_system_spawn(gs, opts)
	}
}

try_attack :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, player: ^Entity) {
	attack_pressed := gs.input["attack"] == .Pressed

	if attack_pressed && gs.attack_cooldown_timer <= 0 {
		if gs.combo_window_timer > 0 {
			gs.player_movement_state = .Attack_Second
			switch_animation(player, "attack_2")
			player.vel *= 0.3
		} else {
			switch_animation(player, "attack")
			gs.player_movement_state = .Attack_First
			gs.buffered_second_attack = false
			player.vel *= 0.5
		}
	}
}

try_activate_checkpoint :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, player: ^Entity) {
	if gs.input["up"] == .Pressed {
		for checkpoint in gs.level.checkpoints {
			rect := rect_from_pos_size(checkpoint.pos - 16, 32)

			if rl.CheckCollisionRecs(rect, player.collider) {
				gs.save_data.level_id = gs.level.id
				gs.save_data.checkpoint_coords = coords_from_pos(checkpoint.pos)

				// Current session
				gs.checkpoint_pos = checkpoint.pos - TILE_SIZE
				gs.checkpoint_level_id = gs.level.id

				save_data_update(gs)
				savefile_save(gs.save_data)
			}
		}
	}
}

try_dash :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, player: ^Entity, input_dir: Vec2) {
	if .Dash not_in gs.save_data.collected_power_ups do return

	if gs.input["dash"] == .Pressed {
		if gs.dash_cooldown_timer <= 0 {

			// Local copy so we can adjust the fields
			input_dir := input_dir

			if input_dir == 0 {
				if .Left in player.flags {
					input_dir.x = -1
				} else {
					input_dir.x = 1
				}
			}

			switch_animation(player, "dash")
			gs.player_movement_state = .Dash
			gs.dash_timer = DASH_DURATION
			player.vel = DASH_VELOCITY * input_dir

			append(&gs.screen_shakers, Screen_Shake {strength = 1, timer = 0.2})
		}
	}
}

player_attack_sfx :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, player: ^Entity) {
	if int(gs.camera.target.x) % 2 == 0 {
		rl.PlaySound(gs.sword_swoosh_sound)
	} else {
		rl.PlaySound(gs.sword_swoosh_sound_2)
	}
}

player_attack_callback :: proc(gs: ^Game_State, player: ^Entity) {
	center := Vec2{player.x, player.y}
	center += {.Left in player.flags ? -30 + player.collider.width : 30, 20}
	// Draw attack hitbox
	debug_draw_circle(center, 25, rl.RED, true)

	for &e, i in gs.entities {
		id := Entity_Id(i)
		if id == gs.player_id do continue
		if .Dead in e.flags do continue
		if .Immortal in e.flags do continue

		if rl.CheckCollisionCircleRec(center, 25, e.hurtbox) {
			entity_damage(Entity_Id(i), 1)

			a := rect_center(player.collider)
			b := rect_center(e.collider)
			dir := linalg.normalize0(b - a)

			if .Bleeds in e.flags {
				opts := Particle_System_Options {
					pos = b,
					rotation = {0, 360},
					frequency = 0.01,
					lifetime = 0.01,
					emission_rate = 10,
					particle = {
						lifetime = {0.5, 1},
						initial_size = {1, 1},
						velocity = {50, 80},
						bounce_loss = 0.99,
						transparency = {0, 1},
						color = rl.RED,
						variance = 360,
					}
				}
				particle_system_spawn(gs, opts)
			}

			gs.attack_recovery_timer = ATTACK_RECOVERY_DURATION

			entity_hit(Entity_Id(i), dir * 500)
			rl.PlaySound(gs.sword_hit_medium_sound)
		}
	}

	for &falling_log in gs.falling_logs {
		if falling_log.state != .Default do continue

		log_center := rect_center(falling_log.collider)
		rope_pos := Vec2{log_center.x, log_center.y - falling_log.collider.height / 2}
		rect := Rect{rope_pos.x - 1, rope_pos.y - falling_log.rope_height, 2, falling_log.rope_height - TILE_SIZE}

		if rl.CheckCollisionCircleRec(center, 25, rect) {
			falling_log.state = .Falling
			rl.PlaySound(gs.sword_hit_soft_sound)
		}
	}
}

player_on_enter :: proc(self_id, other_id: Entity_Id) {
	player := entity_get(self_id)
	other := entity_get(other_id)

	player.health -= other.on_hit_damage
}

player_on_death :: proc(player: ^Entity, gs: ^Game_State) {
	// TODO: Effects
	if gs.checkpoint_level_id != 0 {
		level_load(gs, gs.checkpoint_level_id, gs.checkpoint_pos)
	} else {
		level_load(gs, FIRST_LEVEL_ID)
	}

	player := player
	player = entity_get(gs.player_id)
	player.health = player.max_health
	player.flags -= {.Dead}
	player.vel = 0
}



================================================
File: src/savefile.odin
================================================
package main

import "core:encoding/json"
import "core:fmt"
import "core:os"
import "core:slice"
import "core:time"

savefile_save :: proc(save_data: Save_Data) -> (success: bool) {
	options := json.Marshal_Options {
		spec = .SJSON,
	}
	data, err := json.marshal(save_data, options, context.temp_allocator)

	if err == nil {
		path := fmt.tprintf("saves/%d.json", save_data.slot)
		success = os.write_entire_file(path, data)
	}

	return
}

savefile_load :: proc(path: string) -> (save_data: Save_Data, ok: bool) {
	data := os.read_entire_file(path) or_return

	// Use permanent storage to save level and checkpoint iid
	// At most, we waste iid * 2 number of bytes
	if json.unmarshal(data, &save_data, .SJSON) == nil {
		ok = true
	}

	return
}

save_data_update :: proc(gs: ^Game_State) {
	gs.save_data.location = gs.level.name

	time_since_update := time.diff(gs.last_update_time, time.now())
	gs.save_data.seconds_played += time.duration_seconds(time_since_update)

	if !slice.contains(gs.save_data.visited_level_ids[:], gs.level.id) {
		append(&gs.save_data.visited_level_ids, gs.level.id)
	}
}



================================================
File: src/util.odin
================================================
package main

import "core:math/linalg"
import rl "vendor:raylib"

rect_center :: #force_inline proc(r: Rect) -> Vec2 {
	return Vec2{r.x, r.y} + Vec2{r.width, r.height} * 0.5
}

rect_scale :: #force_inline proc(r: Rect, s: f32) -> Rect {
	return Rect{r.x, r.y, r.width * s, r.height * s}
}

rect_scale_all :: #force_inline proc(r: Rect, s: f32) -> Rect {
	return Rect{r.x * s, r.y * s, r.width * s, r.height * s}
}

rect_to_screen :: #force_inline proc(r: Rect, c: rl.Camera2D) -> Rect {
	pos := rl.GetWorldToScreen2D({r.x, r.y}, c)
	return rect_scale({pos.x, pos.y, r.width, r.height}, c.zoom)
}

// pos, coords: relative to the current level
// always starts at 0,0 and goes until level_max/columns,rows

coords_from_pos :: #force_inline proc(pos: Vec2) -> Vec2i {
	coordsf := pos / TILE_SIZE
	coordsf = linalg.floor(coordsf)
	return Vec2i{i32(coordsf.x), i32(coordsf.y)}
}

pos_from_coords :: #force_inline proc(coords: Vec2i) -> Vec2 {
	return Vec2{f32(coords.x), f32(coords.y)} * TILE_SIZE
}

rect_from_pos_size :: #force_inline proc(pos, size: Vec2) -> Rect {
	return Rect{pos.x, pos.y, size.x, size.y}
}

rect_pos_add :: #force_inline proc(rect: Rect, v: Vec2) -> Rect {
	return Rect{rect.x + v.x, rect.y + v.y, rect.width, rect.height}
}

rect_size :: #force_inline proc(r: Rect) -> Vec2 {
	return Vec2{r.width, r.height}
}

map_next_key :: proc(m: ^map[$T]$V, current_key: Maybe(T) = nil) -> T {
	result: T
	first := true
	return_next_key := current_key == nil

	for k in m {
		if first {
			result = k
			first = false
		}

		if return_next_key {
			result = k
			break
		}

		if k == current_key do return_next_key = true
	}

	return result
}
